blocks.source: Canto XXVI
blocks.translation: Canto XXVI

blocks.source: Godi, Fiorenza, poi che se’ sì grande
blocks.translation: Rejoice, O Florence, since thou art so great,

blocks.source: che per mare e per terra batti l’ali,
blocks.translation: That over sea and land thou beatest thy wings,

blocks.source: e per lo ’nferno tuo nome si spande!
blocks.translation: And throughout Hell thy name is spread abroad!

blocks.source: Tra li ladron trovai cinque cotali
blocks.translation: Among the thieves five citizens of thine

blocks.source: tuoi cittadini onde mi ven vergogna,
blocks.translation: Like these I found, whence shame comes unto me,

blocks.source: e tu in grande orranza non ne sali.
blocks.translation: And thou thereby to no great honour risest.

blocks.source: Ma se presso al mattin del ver si sogna,
blocks.translation: But if when morn is near our dreams are true,

blocks.source: tu sentirai, di qua da picciol tempo,
blocks.translation: Feel shalt thou in a little time from now

blocks.source: di quel che Prato, non ch’altri, t’agogna.
blocks.translation: What Prato, if none other, craves for thee.

blocks.source: E se già fosse, non saria per tempo.
blocks.translation: And if it now were, it were not too soon;

blocks.source: Così foss’ ei, da che pur esser dee!
blocks.translation: Would that it were, seeing it needs must be,

blocks.source: ché più mi graverà, com’ più m’attempo.
blocks.translation: For ’twill aggrieve me more the more I age.

blocks.source: Noi ci partimmo, e su per le scalee
blocks.translation: We went our way, and up along the stairs

blocks.source: che n’avea fatto iborni a scender pria,
blocks.translation: The bourns had made us to descend before,

blocks.source: rimontò ’l duca mio e trasse mee;
blocks.translation: Remounted my Conductor and drew me.

blocks.source: e proseguendo la solinga via,
blocks.translation: And following the solitary path

blocks.source: tra le schegge e tra ’ rocchi de lo scoglio
blocks.translation: Among the rocks and ridges of the crag,

blocks.source: lo piè sanza la man non si spedia.
blocks.translation: The foot without the hand sped not at all.

blocks.source: Allor mi dolsi, e ora mi ridoglio
blocks.translation: Then sorrowed I, and sorrow now again,

blocks.source: quando drizzo la mente a ciò ch’io vidi,
blocks.translation: When I direct my mind to what I saw,

blocks.source: e più lo ’ngegno affreno ch’i’ non soglio,
blocks.translation: And more my genius curb than I am wont,

blocks.source: perché non corra che virtù nol guidi;
blocks.translation: That it may run not unless virtue guide it;

blocks.source: sì che, se stella bona o miglior cosa
blocks.translation: So that if some good star, or better thing,

blocks.source: m’ha dato ’l ben, ch’io stessi nol m’invidi.
blocks.translation: Have given me good, I may myself not grudge it.

blocks.source: Quante ’l villan ch’al poggio si riposa,
blocks.translation: As many as the hind (who on the hill

blocks.source: nel tempo che colui che ’l mondo schiara
blocks.translation: Rests at the time when he who lights the world

blocks.source: la faccia sua a noi tien meno ascosa,
blocks.translation: His countenance keeps least concealed from us,

blocks.source: come la mosca cede a la zanzara,
blocks.translation: While as the fly gives place unto the gnat)

blocks.source: vede lucciole giù per la vallea,
blocks.translation: Seeth the glow-worms down along the valley,

blocks.source: forse colà dov’ e’ vendemmia e ara:
blocks.translation: Perchance there where he ploughs and makes his vintage;

blocks.source: di tante fiamme tutta risplendea
blocks.translation: With flames as manifold resplendent all

blocks.source: l’ottava bolgia, sì com’ io m’accorsi
blocks.translation: Was the eighth Bolgia, as I grew aware

blocks.source: tosto che fui là ’ve ’l fondo parea.
blocks.translation: As soon as I was where the depth appeared.

blocks.source: E qual colui che si vengiò con li orsi
blocks.translation: And such as he who with the bears avenged him

blocks.source: vide ’l carro d’Elia al dipartire,
blocks.translation: Beheld Elijah’s chariot at departing,

blocks.source: quando i cavalli al cielo erti levorsi,
blocks.translation: What time the steeds to heaven erect uprose,

blocks.source: che nol potea sì con li occhi seguire,
blocks.translation: For with his eye he could not follow it

blocks.source: ch’el vedesse altro che la fiamma sola,
blocks.translation: So as to see aught else than flame alone,

blocks.source: sì come nuvoletta, in sù salire:
blocks.translation: Even as a little cloud ascending upward,

blocks.source: tal si move ciascuna per la gola
blocks.translation: Thus each along the gorge of the intrenchment

blocks.source: del fosso, ché nessuna mostra ’l furto,
blocks.translation: Was moving; for not one reveals the theft,

blocks.source: e ogne fiamma un peccatore invola.
blocks.translation: And every flame a sinner steals away.

blocks.source: Io stava sovra ’l ponte a veder surto,
blocks.translation: I stood upon the bridge uprisen to see,

blocks.source: sì che s’io non avessi un ronchion preso,
blocks.translation: So that, if I had seized not on a rock,

blocks.source: caduto sarei giù sanz’ esser urto.
blocks.translation: Down had I fallen without being pushed.

blocks.source: E ’l duca che mi vide tanto atteso,
blocks.translation: And the Leader, who beheld me so attent,

blocks.source: disse: «Dentro dai fuochi son li spirti;
blocks.translation: Exclaimed: “Within the fires the spirits are;

blocks.source: catun si fascia di quel ch’elli è inceso».
blocks.translation: Each swathes himself with that wherewith he burns.”

blocks.source: «Maestro mio», rispuos’ io, «per udirti
blocks.translation: “My Master,” I replied, “by hearing thee

blocks.source: son io più certo; ma già m’era avviso
blocks.translation: I am more sure; but I surmised already

blocks.source: che così fosse, e già voleva dirti:
blocks.translation: It might be so, and already wished to ask thee

blocks.source: chi è ’n quel foco che vien sì diviso
blocks.translation: Who is within that fire, which comes so cleft

blocks.source: di sopra, che par surger de la pira
blocks.translation: At top, it seems uprising from the pyre

blocks.source: dov’ Eteòcle col fratel fu miso?».
blocks.translation: Where was Eteocles with his brother placed.”

blocks.source: Rispuose a me: «Là dentro si martira
blocks.translation: He answered me: “Within there are tormented

blocks.source: Ulisse e Dïomede, e così insieme
blocks.translation: Ulysses and Diomed, and thus together

blocks.source: a la vendetta vanno come a l’ira;
blocks.translation: They unto vengeance run as unto wrath.

blocks.source: e dentro da la lor fiamma si geme
blocks.translation: And there within their flame do they lament

blocks.source: l’agguato del caval che fé la porta
blocks.translation: The ambush of the horse, which made the door

blocks.source: onde uscì de’ Romani il gentil seme.
blocks.translation: Whence issued forth the Romans’ gentle seed;

blocks.source: Piangevisi entro l’arte per che, morta,
blocks.translation: Therein is wept the craft, for which being dead

blocks.source: Deïdamìa ancor si duol d’Achille,
blocks.translation: Deidamia still deplores Achilles,

blocks.source: e del Palladio pena vi si porta».
blocks.translation: And pain for the Palladium there is borne.”

blocks.source: «S’ei posson dentro da quelle faville
blocks.translation: “If they within those sparks possess the power

blocks.source: parlar», diss’ io, «maestro, assai ten priego
blocks.translation: To speak,” I said, “thee, Master, much I pray,

blocks.source: e ripriego, che ’l priego vaglia mille,
blocks.translation: And re-pray, that the prayer be worth a thousand,

blocks.source: che non mi facci de l’attender niego
blocks.translation: That thou make no denial of awaiting

blocks.source: fin che la fiamma cornuta qua vegna;
blocks.translation: Until the horned flame shall hither come;

blocks.source: vedi che del disio ver’ lei mi piego!».
blocks.translation: Thou seest that with desire I lean towards it.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «La tua preghiera è degna
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Worthy is thy entreaty

blocks.source: di molta loda, e io però l’accetto;
blocks.translation: Of much applause, and therefore I accept it;

blocks.source: ma fa che la tua lingua si sostegna.
blocks.translation: But take heed that thy tongue restrain itself.

blocks.source: Lascia parlare a me, ch’i’ ho concetto
blocks.translation: Leave me to speak, because I have conceived

blocks.source: ciò che tu vuoi; ch’ei sarebbero schivi,
blocks.translation: That which thou wishest; for they might disdain

blocks.source: perch’ e’ fuor greci, forse del tuo detto».
blocks.translation: Perchance, since they were Greeks, discourse of thine.”

blocks.source: Poi che la fiamma fu venuta quivi
blocks.translation: When now the flame had come unto that point,

blocks.source: dove parve al mio duca tempo e loco,
blocks.translation: Where to my Leader it seemed time and place,

blocks.source: in questa forma lui parlare audivi:
blocks.translation: After this fashion did I hear him speak:

blocks.source: «O voi che siete due dentro ad un foco,
blocks.translation: “O ye, who are twofold within one fire,

blocks.source: s’io meritai di voi mentre ch’io vissi,
blocks.translation: If I deserved of you, while I was living,

blocks.source: s’io meritai di voi assai o poco
blocks.translation: If I deserved of you or much or little

blocks.source: quando nel mondo li alti versi scrissi,
blocks.translation: When in the world I wrote the lofty verses,

blocks.source: non vi movete; ma l’un di voi dica
blocks.translation: Do not move on, but one of you declare

blocks.source: dove, per lui, perduto a morir gissi».
blocks.translation: Whither, by his own course, being lost, he went to die.”

blocks.source: Lo maggior corno de la fiamma antica
blocks.translation: Then of the antique flame the greater horn,

blocks.source: cominciò a crollarsi mormorando,
blocks.translation: Murmuring, began to wave itself about

blocks.source: pur come quella cui vento affatica;
blocks.translation: Even as a flame doth which the wind fatigues.

blocks.source: indi la cima qua e là menando,
blocks.translation: Thereafterward, the summit to and fro

blocks.source: come fosse la lingua che parlasse,
blocks.translation: Moving as if it were the tongue that spake,

blocks.source: gittò voce di fuori e disse: «Quando
blocks.translation: It uttered forth a voice, and said: “When I

blocks.source: mi diparti’ da Circe, che sottrasse
blocks.translation: From Circe had departed, who concealed me

blocks.source: me più d’un anno là presso a Gaeta,
blocks.translation: More than a year there near unto Gaeta,

blocks.source: prima che sì Enëa la nomasse,
blocks.translation: Or ever yet Aeneas named it so,

blocks.source: né dolcezza di figlio, né la pieta
blocks.translation: Nor fondness for my son, nor reverence

blocks.source: del vecchio padre, né ’l debito amore
blocks.translation: For my old father, nor the due affection

blocks.source: lo qual dovea Penelopè far lieta,
blocks.translation: Which joyous should have made Penelope,

blocks.source: vincer potero dentro a me l’ardore
blocks.translation: Could overcome within me the desire

blocks.source: ch’i’ ebbi a divenir del mondo esperto
blocks.translation: I had to be experienced of the world,

blocks.source: e de li vizi umani e del valore;
blocks.translation: And of the vice and virtue of mankind;

blocks.source: ma misi me per l’alto mare aperto
blocks.translation: But I put forth on the high open sea

blocks.source: sol con un legno e con quella compagna
blocks.translation: With one sole ship, and that small company

blocks.source: picciola da la qual non fui diserto.
blocks.translation: By which I never had deserted been.

blocks.source: L’un lito e l’altro vidi infin la Spagna,
blocks.translation: Both of the shores I saw as far as Spain,

blocks.source: fin nel Morrocco, e l’isola d’i Sardi,
blocks.translation: Far as Morocco, and the isle of Sardinia,

blocks.source: e l’altre che quel mare intorno bagna.
blocks.translation: And the others which that sea bathes round about.

blocks.source: Io e ’ compagni eravam vecchi e tardi
blocks.translation: I and my company were old and slow

blocks.source: quando venimmo a quella foce stretta
blocks.translation: When at that narrow passage we arrived

blocks.source: dov’ Ercule segnò li suoi riguardi
blocks.translation: Where Hercules his landmarks set as signals,

blocks.source: acciò che l’uom più oltre non si metta;
blocks.translation: That man no farther onward should adventure.

blocks.source: da la man destra mi lasciai Sibilia,
blocks.translation: On the right hand behind me left I Seville,

blocks.source: da l’altra già m’avea lasciata Setta.
blocks.translation: And on the other already had left Ceuta.

blocks.source: “O frati”, dissi “che per cento milia
blocks.translation: ‘O brothers, who amid a hundred thousand

blocks.source: perigli siete giunti a l’occidente,
blocks.translation: Perils,’ I said, ‘have come unto the West,

blocks.source: a questa tanto picciola vigilia
blocks.translation: To this so inconsiderable vigil

blocks.source: d’i nostri sensi ch’è del rimanente
blocks.translation: Which is remaining of your senses still

blocks.source: non vogliate negar l’esperïenza,
blocks.translation: Be ye unwilling to deny the knowledge,

blocks.source: di retro al sol, del mondo sanza gente.
blocks.translation: Following the sun, of the unpeopled world.

blocks.source: Considerate la vostra semenza:
blocks.translation: Consider ye the seed from which ye sprang;

blocks.source: fatti non foste a viver come bruti,
blocks.translation: Ye were not made to live like unto brutes,

blocks.source: ma per seguir virtute e canoscenza”.
blocks.translation: But for pursuit of virtue and of knowledge.’

blocks.source: Li miei compagni fec’ io sì aguti,
blocks.translation: So eager did I render my companions,

blocks.source: con questa orazion picciola, al cammino,
blocks.translation: With this brief exhortation, for the voyage,

blocks.source: che a pena poscia li avrei ritenuti;
blocks.translation: That then I hardly could have held them back.

blocks.source: e volta nostra poppa nel mattino,
blocks.translation: And having turned our stern unto the morning,

blocks.source: de’ remi facemmo ali al folle volo,
blocks.translation: We of the oars made wings for our mad flight,

blocks.source: sempre acquistando dal lato mancino.
blocks.translation: Evermore gaining on the larboard side.

blocks.source: Tutte le stelle già de l’altro polo
blocks.translation: Already all the stars of the other pole

blocks.source: vedea la notte, e ’l nostro tanto basso,
blocks.translation: The night beheld, and ours so very low

blocks.source: che non surgëa fuor del marin suolo.
blocks.translation: It did not rise above the ocean surface.

blocks.source: Cinque volte racceso e tante casso
blocks.translation: Five times rekindled and as many quenched

blocks.source: lo lume era di sotto da la luna,
blocks.translation: Had been the splendour underneath the moon,

blocks.source: poi che ’ntrati eravam ne l’alto passo,
blocks.translation: Since we had entered into the deep pass,

blocks.source: quando n’apparve una montagna, bruna
blocks.translation: When there appeared to us a mountain, dim

blocks.source: per la distanza, e parvemi alta tanto
blocks.translation: From distance, and it seemed to me so high

blocks.source: quanto veduta non avëa alcuna.
blocks.translation: As I had never any one beheld.

blocks.source: Noi ci allegrammo, e tosto tornò in pianto;
blocks.translation: Joyful were we, and soon it turned to weeping;

blocks.source: ché de la nova terra un turbo nacque
blocks.translation: For out of the new land a whirlwind rose,

blocks.source: e percosse del legno il primo canto.
blocks.translation: And smote upon the fore part of the ship.

blocks.source: Tre volte il fé girar con tutte l’acque;
blocks.translation: Three times it made her whirl with all the waters,

blocks.source: a la quarta levar la poppa in suso
blocks.translation: At the fourth time it made the stern uplift,

blocks.source: e la prora ire in giù, com’ altrui piacque,
blocks.translation: And the prow downward go, as pleased Another,

blocks.source: infin che ’l mar fu sovra noi richiuso».
blocks.translation: Until the sea above us closed again.”
